title: Democrats Gain Midterms Edge as Trump Drags Down Republicans, Per Times/Siena Poll
summary: Even some Republicans are losing faith in Trump’s economy, a New York Times/Siena poll found, and Democrats were favored on the top issues as the sprint to the midterms gets underway.
